provenance.title: The Founding Trilogy, Book 1 -- reader notes

records.title: Chapter 1: The recruit arrives at Ravenhold
facts: Mara Venn is introduced as a 17-year-old conscript with no prior combat training.
Ravenhold Keep is a mountain garrison controlled by the Warden's Order at the story's start.
Warden Sethe is the fortress commander and Mara's first authority figure.
quotesOrRefs: "Nobody leaves Ravenhold the same." -- Warden Sethe, Ch. 1

records.title: Chapter 7: The first patrol
records.inUniverseSpan: Book 1, the depths of the first winter
facts: After a month of training, Mara is assigned to her first patrol, on the eastern wall under Sergeant Odo Brask.
On the eastern wall, Brask teaches Mara to fight with a short spear rather than a sword.
On that first patrol the recruits find ash-marked tracks leading toward the Greyfen marsh.

records.title: Chapter 14: Sethe's betrayal is revealed
facts: Warden Sethe is revealed to have secretly sworn to the Ashen Pact before the events of Book 1.
Sethe admits that Mara was taken on as an apprentice on the Pact's orders.
The oath is revealed in Book 1 Chapter 14, when Sethe's pact-mark is exposed during the siege.
quotesOrRefs: Reveal scene, Ch. 14 -- Sethe's pact-mark is exposed during the siege.

records.title: Chapter 22: The fall of Ravenhold
records.inUniverseSpan: Book 1, the forty-first and final night of the siege
facts: Ravenhold Keep falls to the Ashen Pact on the final night of the siege.
During the fall, Sergeant Brask dies holding the eastern gate so the garrison can escape.
As the keep falls, Mara leads the surviving recruits out through the cistern tunnels.

records.title: Chapter 30 (pending review, never accepted)
facts: Mara swears her own oath to the Free Companies.
